title: OpenAI shares its models' perplexity, or how well they predict data, and urges pacing limits based on such metrics, citing a possible 2027 avalanche of AI gains (Jakub Pachocki/OpenAI)
summary: Jakub Pachocki / OpenAI: OpenAI shares its models' perplexity, or how well they predict data, and urges pacing limits based on such metrics, citing a possible 2027 avalanche of AI gains — - Difficulty of comparison across labs. … - Detachment from actionable evaluations. … - Not accounting for advances outside of pretraining.
